messages:
Elena (Finance): @channel Heads-up: on 2026-08-01 we will consolidate per-route minute metering into a single account-level free-minute pool and introduce per-route soft caps to reduce invoice noise and make burst behavior predictable.

Ben (Product): TL;DR: new model = account free-minute pool (default 5,000 min/mo). Each route will have a soft cap (80% of pool by default) and a hard cap. Hitting a soft cap triggers deprioritization (not a hard block) and descriptive headers; overage pricing applies only past the hard cap.

Maya (Billing): Notes for data/eng: migration preview CSV required by 2026-07-01. Flag accounts where projected overage delta >20% and include columns: account_id, current_monthly_minutes, projected_pool, rollback_eligible (bool), migration_id. We'll emit billing.event.minute_pool_migration.v1 at cutover.

Sam (Eng): Need spec: X-Minute-Pool, X-Route-SoftCap, X-Overage-Estimate headers on responses. Also add a /billing/preview API that returns migration_id and projected invoice delta.

Lina (Support): Playbook: if customer reports unexpected overage >25%, escalate to #billing-escalations and attach preview output. If within 30-day dispute window, open a dispute ticket and tag billing+finance.

Raj (Legal): Email footer copy (short): "We may adjust metering and overage rates; see your console for account-specific details. Dispute window: 30 days." Final legal line to be posted by 2026-06-25.

ops-billing-bot: preview_job queued -> scheduled 2026-07-01T04:00:00Z

Elena (Finance): Timeline recap: 2026-07-01 preview CSV -> internal teams; 2026-07-15 console banner + queued emails; 2026-08-01 cutover; 30-day dispute window after invoices. Safety: if >0.7% of active accounts dispute within first 72 hours, pause migration and run RCA.

Ben (Product): Customer-facing console blurb draft:

"Starting August 1, 2026 were simplifying minute metering. Your annual allotment is unchanged; we now allocate it as a straightforward account-level minute pool. Preview the converted pool and estimated invoice impact in the simulator. Contact sales for custom pools."

Lina (Support): Sample reply for agents:

"Hi <customer>, we consolidated minute metering on Aug 1 into a single free-minute pool. Your preview shows [+/\- X%] change vs prior month. If you'd like us to open a dispute within the 30-day window or request a custom pool, let us know and we'll escalate. — Lina, Support"

Elena (Finance): Action items: Maya -> preview CSV by 2026-07-01; Eng -> preview API + response headers by 2026-07-10; Support -> training + dispute intake by 2026-07-12; Legal -> final email line by 2026-06-25.
